caption: The four wires pass through three stages of comparators. Stage 1 makes the first half rise and the second half fall; stages 2 and 3 merge the result into [1, 2, 3, 4].

spec.title: 4-input bitonic network, depth 3
spec.aria: Four rows of four numbers showing the input and the three stages of a 4-input bitonic sorting network ending sorted.
